finding.title: The code constructs a URL using user input (`country` and `year`). If the user input is not properly validated, it could lead to OS command injection.
The code outputs user input directly to the console without any sanitization. This could lead to XSS if the input is malicious.
The code uses `curl_easy_setopt` with `CURLOPT_URL` which takes a string. If the string is not properly validated, it could lead to argument injection.
The code uses `htmlReadDoc` with a string that contains user input. If the string is not properly validated, it could lead to OS command injection.
The code uses `xmlXPathEvalExpression` with a string that contains user input. If the string is not properly validated, it could lead to OS command injection.
